title: The Archive of Sector Nine Again
author: Casper Ravensworth
blurb: Quentin Vane, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
